statutory_framework.two_wheeler_child_rule: Rule 138(7), Central Motor Vehicles Rules, 1989 (MoRTH G.S.R. 1361(E))

infant.mounting: Rear passenger seat secured via ISOFIX anchors or 3-point adult seatbelt

toddler.recommended_system: Forward-Facing Child Restraint System with 5-point harness
toddler.mounting: Rear passenger seat secured via top tether and ISOFIX

young_child.mounting: Rear passenger seat positioning vehicle lap-and-shoulder belt correctly over chest

adolescent.mounting: Rear passenger seat; front seat strictly discouraged until 12+ years

mandatory_requirements: Safety harness securing child to driver (Bureau of Indian Standards BIS certified)
Crash helmet matching child head dimensions (ISI marked)
Vehicle speed must strictly not exceed 40 km/h when carrying child pillion
two_wheeler_pillion_child.penalty: Fine under Section 177 / 194B(2) MVA plus driving licence suspension for 3 months under Sec 19 MVA.
